personalInfo.name: Yash Dedhia
personalInfo.title: AI Engineer
personalInfo.statement: I turn ambiguous requirements into production AI systems.
personalInfo.intro: AI engineer with five years of experience shipping software systems end to end. I build production agentic workflows, evaluation-driven RAG systems, and full-stack products—including ShareMyVault, now used by 100+ people.

experience.summary: Engineer #2, working in a forward-deployed capacity to translate ambiguous stakeholder requirements into production AI and full-stack systems.
bullets: Architected a LangGraph asset-onboarding workflow that reduced a 12-step manual process to one automated workflow across three systems, cutting onboarding time by 75% per asset.
Built a RAG evaluation suite for citation, grounding, and context recall, reducing unsupported responses by 60% and improving grounded-answer pass rate from 72% to 91%.
Delivered agentic workflows with 90%+ successful task completion inside a private network using open-source models and company security controls.
Reduced backend and database requests by 70% by preloading and caching read data client-side in a Vue.js application.
Shipped Node.js and Flutter applications, payment integrations, and PostgreSQL systems with RLS, message queues, pgvector, and scheduled jobs.

experience.summary: Work Integrated Learning engagement through RMIT, focused on secure GenAI knowledge access in a healthcare environment.
bullets: Built and deployed a serverless GenAI knowledge-access application across AWS and Azure.
Evaluated RAG quality with LLM-as-a-judge across groundedness, relevance, and completeness, improving answer accuracy from approximately 78% to 92%.
Designed data flows around healthcare privacy requirements so PII and PHI remained within approved infrastructure and compliance controls.

experience.summary: Full-stack engineering for an enterprise customer identity and access management platform.
bullets: Developed and maintained backend APIs using .NET Core and MySQL for a CIAM system.
Architected and optimized RESTful microservices supporting authentication, analytics workflows, and backend data access.
Improved API performance by 30%, implemented role-based authentication modules, and built frontend features in Angular.js.

experience.summary: Built and operated an internal inventory-management platform for approximately 50 staff.
bullets: Built a FastAPI, MySQL, and Next.js inventory system supporting roughly 1,500 SKUs and 100 daily orders.
Replaced manual ordering with a digital workflow that improved order tracking, inventory visibility, and coordination across remote teams.
Created staff interfaces for inventory lookup, record management, and order processing.
Trained all 50 internal staff members, supporting 100% adoption across day-to-day operations.

products.name: ShareMyVault
products.tagline: Estate planning people can actually finish.
products.description: An AI-powered estate-planning platform for wills, legacy planning, and guided support, designed for expats, seniors, and non-technical users.
bullets: Grew the platform to 100+ live users and secured a Sarvam AI API grant for multilingual voice capabilities.
Built a cross-platform Flutter app with multilingual speech-to-text and text-to-speech.
Designed the web and mobile products around zero-knowledge encryption to protect sensitive user data.
Developed conversational workflows that turn complex estate-planning decisions into clear, guided steps.

products.name: AgentLens
products.tagline: See your website the way AI does.
products.description: An early AI-search readiness platform, conceived before AI SEO became a recognised category.
bullets: Evaluated accessibility, structured data, crawlability, and LLM interpretability.
Built autonomous crawling with robots.txt parsing, multi-page exploration, metadata extraction, and WCAG audits.
Developed simulation agents that emulate how ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity interpret and retrieve website content.
